title: Live Trump Prison-Cell Billboard in Tehran’s Tajrish Square
text:
Live Trump Prison-Cell Billboard in Tehran’s Tajrish Square"

""
"The story:"
"A new billboard in Tehran’s Tajrish Square has been unveiled with a prison-cell-style setting. According to the organizers, the installation features a live actor performing as “Trump” inside the cell-like display. The billboard carries the Persian slogan “ندیدن این صحنه جرم است” — translated as “Not seeing this scene is a crime.” Organizers say it is intended to operate 24/7, drawing attention from passersby in one of Tehran’s busiest public squares.
